source: generic reference: a broadcast football graphics package (score bug, venue ident, goal lower third, replay stinger)
why: One compact score bug top-left, a lower third on goals and a replay stinger, set in one licensed sans family
match: score bug: club tags, score and clock in one strip, top-left, never over the ball or the players
venue ident on kickoff and a goal lower third (scorer, minute) for about two seconds
a REPLAY stinger opens and closes the goal replay; text never smaller than 12 px on a 390x844 phone
one licensed face for all chrome (no system-ui fallback as the face)
